newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Fibre sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Fibre sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Advanced Fibre Communications Inc Tuesday announced its intention to declare a two-for-one stock split of its common stock.

The company also announced its Board of Directors has called a special meeting of stockholders for the purpose of attaining stockholder approval of an increase in its authorized common stock in anticipation of the proposed stock split.
As of July 26, 1997, AFC had approximately 36 million shares outstanding.
The special meeting of stockholders is scheduled for September 22.
